items.body: تحدث خافيير كليمنتي، مدرب منتخب إسبانيا السابق، عن مستقبل إيميريك لابورت، مدافع أتلتيك بيلباو، والذي يرتبط اسمه بالانتقال إلى برشلونة، لتعويض رحيل رونالد أراوخو. ورغم أن برشلونة يمتلك 4 مدافعين، إضافة إلى إمكانية تصعيد ألفارو كورتيس إلى الفريق الأول، فإن المدير الرياضي ديكو، يدرس عدة خيارات لتعزيز الدفاع، ومن أبرزها روميرو ولابورت. ونشرت صحيفة سبورت ، تصريحات خافيير كليمنتي، الذي سبق له تدريب أتلتيك بيلباو. وقال كليمنتي في تصريحات لشبكة EREM News "أنا ضد انتقال لابورت إلى صفوف برشلونة". وأضاف "لابورت لاعب كبير، لكنني لا أعتقد أنه سينتقل إلى برشلونة، لأنه انضم إلى أتلتيك بيلباو مؤخرًا من النصر السعودي". ويستبعد كليمنتي، رحيل قلب الدفاع عن أتلتيك بيلباو هذا الصيف، بعدما عاد إلى صفوف الفريق الباسكي في الصيف الماضي، قادمًا من النصر السعودي. وتابع "لابورت لا غنى عنه في خطط النادي الباسكي، وأنا ضد انتقاله إلى برشلونة، وضد رحيل أي لاعب من القائمة الحالية لأتلتيك بيلباو قبل أيام قليلة من انطلاق الموسم". ويطلب أتلتيك بيلباو 80 مليون يورو، للسماح برحيل لابورت، الذي شكل ثنائيًا في قلب دفاع المنتخب الإسباني خلال كأس العالم، مع باو كوبارسي.

items.body: أحدهما أسطورة ملكية يعاني ثنائي ريال مدريد السابق، داني كارفاخال وخوسيلو، من وضع حرج للغاية، حيث يتدربان حاليًا في مدينة كرة القدم في لاس روزاس بمدريد، بينما يدرسان مستقبلهما خلال الميركاتو الجاري.  بعد عدم تجديد عقديهما مع نادييهما، ريال مدريد والغرافة القطري، يبحث اللاعبان عن مغامرة جديدة لإنهاء مسيرتهما الكروية. وقالت صحيفة " آس "، إن اللاعبين يتمتعان بمكانة وشهرة تؤهلهما لجذب العديد من العروض. ومع ذلك، حتى في أغسطس، لم يحسما أمرهما بعد بشأن وجهتهما المقبلة.  لكنهما يستخدمان مرافق الاتحاد الإسباني لكرة القدم للبدء في الاستعداد لتحدياتهما القادمة. كلاهما معروفان جيدًا داخل الاتحاد، وكانا ضمن المنتخب الإسباني الذي فاز ببطولة أوروبا عام 2024. تبددت إحدى خيارات مستقبل الظهير الإسباني قبل أن تلوح في الأفق. بدا كل شيء يشير إلى أن المستقبل يكمن في لم شملها في كرة القدم القطرية.  إلا أن قرار المهاجم بعدم تجديد عقده مع النادي الذي انضم إليه منذ عام 2024 غيّر تلك الخطط. ولذلك، فهما يتواجدان حاليًا في مدريد لاتخاذ قرار بشأن مستقبلهما.  وبينما لم يُحسم هذا الأمر، يبدأ الثنائي تدريباته التحضيرية للموسم الجديد بشكل منفصل. ولا شك أن اللعب معًا مجددًا خيارٌ سيُغري العائلتين. كانت المواسم القليلة الماضية لكلا اللاعبين مختلفة تمامًا.. فقد تمكن خوسيلو ، الذي أمضى موسمين في قطر…

items.title: بعد صفقة جيماريش.. آرسنال منفتح على بيع نجمه
items.summary: بات آرسنال منفتحًا على بيع لاعبه البرازيلي جابرييل مارتينيلي، بعد إتمام صفقة مواطنه برونو جيماريش من نيوكاسل مقابل 75 مليون جنيه إسترليني.
items.body: بات آرسنال منفتحًا على بيع لاعبه البرازيلي جابرييل مارتينيلي، بعد إتمام صفقة مواطنه برونو جيماريش من نيوكاسل مقابل 75 مليون جنيه إسترليني. يعزز اللاعب البرازيلي خط وسط آرسنال الذي يضم بالفعل لاعبين مثل ديكلان رايس، ومارتن أوديجارد، ومارتن زوبيميندي، وميكيل ميرينو، وإيبيريتشي إيزي، ومايلز لويس-سكيلي. كما عزز آرسنال خيارات المدرب ميكل أرتيتا على الجناح ، حيث تعاقد مع كريستوس تزوليس في صفقة بلغت قيمتها 34 مليون جنيه إسترليني من نادي كلوب بروج. وافق أرتيتا أيضًا على انتقال اللاعب الدولي اليوناني بعد السماح للياندرو تروسارد بالرحيل في صفقة بلغت قيمتها 15 مليون جنيه إسترليني إلى بشكتاش. لكن تروسارد ليس الجناح الوحيد في آرسنال المرتبط بالانتقال من ملعب الإمارات، حيث أن مارتينيلي أيضًا مرشح محتمل للرحيل بحسب صحيفة " مترو " الإنجليزية. ويعتبر اللاعب البرازيلي من الركائز الأساسية في آرسنال، حيث شارك في 278 مباراة مع الفريق اللندني في جميع المسابقات. لكن مارتينيلي كافح من أجل إحداث تأثير في الموسم الماضي، حيث سجل هدفًا واحدًا فقط في 30 مباراة بالدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز، ومن المتوقع أن يكون خلف اللاعب الجديد تزوليس في ترتيب أرتيتا. وأشارت الصحيفة إلى أن آرسنال تلقى عرضًا مغريًا من جالطة سراي للاستفادة من خدمات مارتينيلي.

items.summary: نهاية سريعة في القلعة الحمراء
items.body: نهاية سريعة في القلعة الحمراء أنهى التونسي محمد علي بن رمضان فصلًا قصيرًا من مسيرته مع الأهلي المصري، بعدما أعلن نادي الشمال القطري، مساء اليوم الأحد، تعاقده رسميًا مع لاعب الوسط الدولي، ليخوض تجربة جديدة في الدوري القطري بداية من الموسم الكروي 2026-2027. ويأمل الشمال أن يشكل انضمام بن رمضان إضافة قوية إلى صفوف الفريق، في ظل الإمكانات الفنية التي يمتلكها والخبرات التي اكتسبها خلال مسيرته مع عدد من الأندية، إلى جانب حضوره الدولي مع منتخب تونس. وأكد الشمال أن محمد علي بن رمضان يمتلك إمكانات فنية عالية تؤهله لتقديم إضافة حقيقية للفريق، مشيرًا إلى الخبرات التي اكتسبها خلال تجاربه السابقة مع الأهلي المصري والترجي التونسي، فضلًا عن تمثيله منتخب تونس. واجتاز اللاعب التونسي الفحوصات الطبية بنجاح، على أن ينضم فورًا إلى تدريبات الشمال، استعدادًا لانطلاق الموسم الكروي الجديد 2026-2027. ومن المقرر أن ينطلق الموسم الجديد من دوري نجوم بنك الدوحة يوم 20 أغسطس الجاري، فيما يخوض الشمال أولى مبارياته في المسابقة يوم 21 أغسطس، عندما يلتقي النادي العربي ضمن منافسات الجولة الأولى. ويطمح بن رمضان إلى استعادة حضوره القوي في التشكيلة الأساسية خلال تجربته الجديدة، بعدما واجه صعوبة في الحصول على فرصة المشاركة بصفة منتظمة مع الأهلي خلال الموسم الماضي.   أرقام بن رمضان مع الأهلي وكان الأهلي قد أعلن رحيل…

items.title: Everyone thinks the iPhone Ultra will crush Samsung. They’re wrong
items.summary: This won't be a blowout.
items.body: Apple won’t be able to waltz in and best the Galaxy Z Fold 8 by default. I understand the company’s track record and mass appeal, but the general consensus I’ve been seeing about Apple’s rumored iPhone Ultra assumes too much. I loved my hands-on time with the Galaxy Z Fold 8, and I can’t wait to get my review unit. It’s a refreshing form factor. And given how much I still enjoy my original Pixel Fold , I don’t expect the novelty to wear off as some claim. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 has made me more interested in the upcoming iPhone Ultra, but Apple has more work to do than people think. I know Apple is still formidable, but Samsung has a chance to hold its own with the Galaxy Z Fold 8.

That’s just the beginning, though, as a recent APK breakdown hints the tool may soon let users add website links as sources directly in the Gemini app, alongside a few other possible changes .

items.title: The Motorola Razr Fold has an accessory problem that no one’s talking about
items.summary: A scratched screen is inevitable for the Razr Fold.
items.body: Foldable phones are fragile. That’s what a lot of people think, and while I don’t think foldables are as delicate as their reputation implies, you should protect a folding phone in the same way you would any other. I hate display scratches, even minor ones, so I always use a screen protector and a case with every phone I have. Then I got the Motorola Razr Fold , and that changed. Not because it’s a phone that doesn’t need screen protectors, but because it’s almost impossible to find quality accessories for the phone.

items.title: The Pixel 10 Pro is a flawed and inconsistent phone — and I’m still using it one year later
items.summary: The Pixel 10 Pro is flawed but lovable.
items.body: I find it hard to believe that it’s been almost a year since I got my Pixel 10 Pro . Since August 28th, it has been my primary phone (almost) every day, and I adore this phone when it’s working as it should. The problem, as is often the case with Pixels, is that it doesn’t always work as Google intended. Looking back, it’s been a year of ups and downs with the Pixel 10 Pro, but it’s still the only phone I want to call my own.

items.body: It’s been more than two months since Google launched the Fitbit Air. While the $99 fitness tracker grabbed most of the attention, one of the biggest changes that arrived alongside it was Google replacing the Fitbit app with Google Health . At the time, Google said Health would become a unified platform for all of its health devices, including Fitbit trackers and Pixel Watches. AI was a major focus with features like the Health Coach, and the company also promised support for data syncing with multiple health platforms, including Apple Health .

items.title: A Snapdragon-powered Pixel might sound amazing. Here’s why it’s a terrible idea
items.summary: Do you really wanna pay a lot more money for your Pixel flagship?
items.body: Credit: David Imel / Android Authority It’s been roughly five years since Google first dropped Snapdragon silicon in Pixel phones in favor of its Tensor processors. I think it’s fair to say this move has been a double-edged sword for the company. Sure, there’s been good everyday performance, capable on-device AI, and great camera capabilities. But the transition also brought modem issues, heating problems, and uncompetitive peak performance. This state of affairs has led enthusiasts to urge Google to return to Snapdragon silicon, and it seems like an intriguing idea at first. But the more I thought about this possibility, the more I realized this probably wouldn’t be a great move for Pixel phones.

items.title: Joe Jonas Says He Sought Therapy After His Solo Album Underperformed
items.summary: Fastlife peaked at No. 15 on the Billboard 200, while its lead single "See No More" reached No. 92 on the Hot 100.
items.body: Joe Jonas has revealed that the disappointing commercial performance of his 2011 solo debut Fastlife triggered panic attacks and physical pain that ultimately led him to seek therapy. The singer reflected on the album’s reception during a recent episode of the Hey Jonas! podcast, which he co-hosts with his Jonas Brothers bandmates and siblings, Nick and Kevin Jonas. Jonas said he had expected the record to match the success the trio had enjoyed at their peak and had tied its outcome to his own self-worth. “Somewhere in my core, I was like, ‘If I do that, then I matter,'” he told his brothers. Fastlife peaked at No. 15 on the Billboard 200, while its lead single “See No More” reached No. 92 on the Hot 100 — results Jonas found deeply deflating. “I started having panic attacks and started having physical pain,” he recalled. He said a doctor found him physically healthy and recommended he see a therapist, a suggestion he initially resisted. “I was like, what do you mean a therapist? I don’t need a therapist. Why would I need a therapist?” he said, adding that he instead took long bike rides to get away from his phone. …

items.body: Credit: Robert Triggs / Android Authority Buying the perfect USB-C charger may look simple at first, but the reality is full of potential gotchas. If you’ve ever reached for your cable only to find that your device is still charging hours later, you’re certainly not alone. In one sense, USB-C and USB Power Delivery were supposed to solve this mess. The universal connector and new regulations, such as those introduced in the EU, were designed to ensure that one charger could support everything. In some ways, that has been a success: USB-C can now be found on almost every phone, tablet, laptop, and more. However, the difference between something that technically works and something that works optimally can still be surprisingly wide.

items.body: NASA/Pablo Garcia Scientists using NASA’s IXPE (Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer) conducted more than 140 hours of observations of the magnetar 1E 1547-5408, shown in this Aug. 5, 2026, artist’s concept, between March and April 2025. In doing so, they may have captured empty space behaving in a way physicists have predicted for 90 years , but never directly observed. items.title: Maybe the FCC was onto something: These routers are phoning home to China with a secret backdoor
items.summary: Of course, because they predate the ban, the FCC continues to permit their sale.
items.body: TL;DR A new report details a massive security flaw in Zbtlink-made routers. The routers are programmed to ping a hard-coded list of servers, traced back to China. Once connected, the routers grant full root access — no authentication required. This past spring, the FCC announced a sweeping ban on new foreign-made routers — like the kind you use to get online with your ISP and connect all your devices to Wi-Fi. This was all done in the name of national security, but just how real of a threat do routers pose? The discovery of a new security vulnerability in some Chinese-made routers may have you looking at the FCC’s action in a slightly more sympathetic light. Jacob Baines at VulnCheck shares his analysis of routers made by Zbtlink, sold under both that and Wiflyer branding. While neither are huge names in the router space, they’re still sold through US retailers like Amazon , and have been around for years — so, plenty of time for these devices to make some inroads on the market.

items.body: 3 Min Read I Am Artemis: Tom Percy As NASA sets its sights on long-term exploration of the Moon and Mars, the agency is increasing the cadence of its Artemis missions. Helping bring these plans to fruition is Tom Percy, manager of systems engineering and integration for NASA’s Human Landing System Program. Tom Percy, manager of systems engineering and integration for NASA’s Human Landing Systems Program, stands in front of an Apollo Program lander exhibit at the U.S. Space and Rocket Center in Huntsville near NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center. items.title: Google Wallet now lets kids tap to pay without giving up parental control
items.summary: Your child gets tap to pay, but not a free pass to overspend.
items.body: TL;DR Google Wallet now supports supervised balances for kids and teens under 18 in the US, giving them a way to make digital payments with parental oversight. Parents can set daily spending limits, view transaction history, receive Family Link purchase alerts, and remotely lock the Wallet if a device is lost. Kids can tap to pay using their Android phone or Wear OS smartwatch anywhere Google Pay is accepted. Giving kids money has always involved a bit of trust. Maybe it’s cash for a weekend outing, a card for an emergency, or money to grab something while they’re out with friends. The problem is that cash is easy to lose, cards can go missing, and it’s not always obvious where the money ended up. That’s exactly the problem Google Wallet is now trying to solve. The company is rolling out supervised Google Wallet balances for children and teenagers under 18 in the US. Instead of handing your child a debit card and simply hoping they spend responsibly, you’ll be able to decide how much money they have access to while still keeping an eye on where it’s going. It’s a much more practical way to let kids start managing their own money without throwing them in at the deep end.

items.title: Mysterious new Garmin smartwatch spotted in FCC filings

The device carries the model number A05170 and has support for LTE and satellite connectivity. It also features 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, Bluetooth Low Energy, ANT/ANT+, and NFC. Now that the Cirqa Smart Band is out, you may be wondering what else Garmin is working on. This will come as a surprise, but it turns out that the company’s next product will be a smartwatch. I know, I know, no one could’ve seen that coming. This smartwatch was recently spotted in a regulatory filing. The folks over at Gadgets and Wearables found the filing sitting in the FCC’s database. These documents don’t include the name of the device, but they do reveal that the model number is A05170. Additionally, Garmin describes the hardware as a portable digital transceiver, but the SAR evaluation report calls it a wrist-worn device.

We’re expecting four phones, plenty of new software tricks, and perhaps a few surprises that haven’t already escaped through the usual leak-shaped holes. Despite all that, it seems most of our readers don’t currently have solid plans to buy one. How do we know this? Well, we ran a poll in a r ecent opinion piece by my colleague Joe Maring, who explained why the Motorola Razr Fold has him questioning his long-standing Pixel loyalty. His argument focused on the Motorola foldable’s cameras, performance, battery life, and charging, but the question we put to you wasn’t related to whether you agreed with his comparisons. We asked more broadly, do you plan on getting any of the new Pixel 11 phones? They haven’t launched yet, so the question was really around your position based on leaks and propensity to upgrade.

items.title: Survey confirms your Fold 8 preference aligns with Samsung pre-orders
items.summary: We need more square phones.
items.body: Samsung’s latest foldable lineup is a departure from what the company’s been doing up to now. Rather than the usual two foldables — a Flip and a Fold — Samsung’s released three, including two book-style Z Fold phones in different aspect ratios. People have seemed excited about the new, wider form factor (the marginally less premium of the two) since before the phones were released , and now a survey Android Authority ‘s been running has confirmed that vibe. In a poll we’ve been running since late July, we asked readers which of the two Z Fold 8 phones they’d be more likely to buy. There were four options: the wide Z Fold 8; the narrow, higher-end Z Fold 8 Ultra; a response for people who hadn’t decided yet; and one for folks who just aren’t interested. After more than 1,000 responses, the wide Z Fold 8 ran away with it, nabbing nearly 60% of all votes.

Truly, language is one of the biggest barriers, but modern technology is breaking it down. AI, translation apps, and certain devices are more accessible and easy to use than ever. Enter the Timekettle X1 Meeting, a device that promises to make multi-language meetings and general translation simple, even when offline. items.title: Signal finally makes using multiple Android devices much easier
items.summary: You no longer have to choose which phone gets to keep your Signal chats.
items.body: TL;DR Signal now lets you link another Android phone or tablet to your existing account. You can optionally transfer your message history and the last 45 days of media. The update also redesigns Android tablet and foldable layout, ditching legacy single-screen navigation. For years, one of Signal’s biggest pain points when compared to other messaging apps wasn’t encryption, voice calls, or missing features. It was the awkward experience of moving between devices. If you wanted to use a second Android phone or tablet, you were largely out of luck. That finally changes with the latest update. Signal has announced a major expansion of its linked devices feature, allowing users to connect another Android phone or Android tablet to their existing account. The feature arrives in Signal Android v8.20, while Signal iOS v8.22 similarly lets iPhone users link another iPhone alongside existing iPad support.

items.title: One year of updates couldn’t save the Pixel 10’s GPU — and now the Pixel 11 is at risk
items.summary: What's the state of play with Android 17 on the Pixel 10?
items.body: Credit: Robert Triggs / Android Authority The Pixel 10 series may be Google’s best phones yet, but gamers got the short end of the stick. The Tensor G5 marked Google’s switch away from Arm’s Mali GPUs in favor of Imagination Technologies’ PowerVR architecture — specifically the mid-range, already aging DXT-48-1536. With the Pixel 11 launch approaching, one question keeps nagging at me: will history repeat itself? Rumors suggest the Tensor G6 will use another modest PowerVR GPU, the CXTP-48-1536. If Google’s recent trajectory is anything to go by, the Pixel 11 could fall even further behind rival flagship GPUs.
